關於我幫助迷路小女孩後，隔壁的美少女留學生開始來家裡玩這件事
synopsis: One day, Charlotte Bennett joins Akito Aoyagi's class as a student studying abroad. Everyone in the class is attracted to Charlotte's beautiful appearance and elegant demeanor, but Akito feels like "we belong in different worlds" and stays away. However, Akito's daily life drastically changes when he rescues Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, when she got lost. He finds out that the Bennett sisters live in the apartment next door to his, and since Emma had taken to Akito, the Bennett sisters start coming over to Akito's place every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akito and Charlotte grow closer, in their own clumsy way… (Source: NicoNico Seiga, translated)

title: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
titleEnglish: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
titleRomaji: Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaete mo Omaera ga Warui!
titleNative: 私がモテないのはどう考えてもお前らが悪い!
synopsis: Kuroki Tomoko is a super popular, high school girl, who has had 50 years of dating experience, and 100 boys... in the Otome game world. In the real world, she is a 15 year old shut in, who has all of the qualities of a "mojo" (喪女, a gloomy or unpopular woman). However, when school isn't going as she expected, and she isn't as popular as she had thought she was, she takes a look at herself in the mirror for the first time in a few years, and has some shocking revelations...
